notes.title: Celebrate Halloween with Tadeo and enjoy a terrifying discount!
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrate Halloween with Tadeo and enjoy a terrifying discount![/h1]

[b]Halloween [/b]season is here and we have another great news for Tadeo fans! To celebrate these special dates, Tadeo Jones - The Emerald Tablet is available until [b]November 3rd[/b] with an incredible [b]discount [/b]that you won't want to miss. From today, you can enjoy the adventures of Tadeo at a reduced price, it's the perfect time to join his legendary adventures in Halloween mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/60c33a7e782ed4a6e542ea4cfde7e6f2560ce875.png[/img]

[b]Here's a reminder of what's new in the Halloween update:[/b]

    - [b]New and terrifying scenarios![/b] Get ready to explore a Chicago full of surprises, both in 2D and 3D, with guaranteed scares and an atmosphere that will make your hair stand on end.
    - [b]Pure Halloween visuals.[/b] Ghosts, pumpkins and bats invade every corner of the game, adding a sinister and fun touch to your adventures.
    - [b]Terrifying sounds![/b] The new soundtrack will keep you in tension, the Halloween sound effects are perfectly integrated into the scenarios to create an even more immersive experience.
    - [b]Spooky gameplay.[/b] Puzzles and challenges tinged with the spirit of Halloween to add an extra dose of excitement.
    - [b]Dressed for the occasion.[/b] Tadeo, Sara and Victoria have decided to join the party with their best costumes for the Day of the Dead.

Don't rest on your laurels, or on your pumpkins, because this magical discount ends on [b]November 3[/b]. Take the opportunity to enjoy the adventures of Tadeo in the purest Halloween style at a scary price... or a laugh!

notes.title: Tad the Lost Explorer Announcement | Wishlist Now on STEAM
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tad_the_Lost_Explorer_and_the_Emerald_Tablet/

True to the film, funny, loaded with tons of  affectionate nods to the movie and humor. The game development studio Gammera Nest has just published a teaser which offers some first clues of what Tad the Lost Explorer will be about, the official videogame that adapts the third film of the adventures of the charismatic explorer, created by Enrique Gato. 

[previewyoutube=uc30Dw5WW1M;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, players can already include in their wishlists this title, which will initially be available on PlayStation and Steam, it promises hours of entertainment for both, IP  followers and their parents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/cbdbc6d57d90623788b45b14ff92c6c59f2adccc.jpg[/img]
 
In this installment, true to the plot of the film, Tad's quest to become a famous archaeologist, leads him to stick his nose into a place where no one should ever have gone. 

As a result, some of his best friends suffer the effect of a terrible curse that can only be reversed by finding the Emerald Tablet, an ancient relic created by a sorcerer to challenge the pharaoh`s power. 

With this premise, Gammera Nest studio, in collaboration with Mediaset Games and PS Talents, has developed a fun game that combines adventure, exploration, puzzles and platforms,  which are the best elements used in the film. 

This game stands out for its variety, alternating open 3D scenarios (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, Egypt), which can be fully explored, as well 2D platform levels, where the player skills will be essential.  It should also be noted the game graphics quality (design and animations), which are very close to the film.

[b]Featured content:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Purest Tad Stones narrative style. 
[*] 3D scenarios which the player can freely explorate, these levels are full of adventures and collectibles. 
[*] 2D level action, try to demonstrate your skill playing as Tad with the controllers. 
[*] Countless nods to the movie and surprises. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/9129106f3141246996f4fa7493d96a92db467d83.jpg[/img]
